title: Ministry of Health — licensed hospitals (مستشفى خاص / مستشفى عام licence lists)
notes: Two licence-list PDFs from the MoH licensing page. No licence number is printed, so source_ref = file#row index. Columns: trade name, hospital type (خاص / عام), specialty (e.g. إختصاص عيون; "---" for general), address, governorate, phone. The type column is ambiguous ("خاص" appears to mean specialised vs "عام" general, not ownership - e.g. الشميساني, المحبه are listed as عام), so ownership is left unknown and the raw value kept in extra.hospital_kind_ar. Names are short trade names as printed (e.g. "الامل للتوليد"), often without the word مستشفى. Phones printed without area code; mobiles dropped. Same glyph-level Arabic repair as moh_licensed_register.
